children: The 27,000 sq ft Prakash Toyota facility takes the automaker’s customer touchpoints in the state to 45

Toyota Kirloskar Motor (TKM) has opened a new dealership in Siliguri, West Bengal, as the automaker expands its retail and after-sales network in the state. The new Prakash Toyota facility is a 3S outlet, offering sales, service and spare parts under one roof.

Located on Sevoke Road, the dealership covers 27,000 sq ft and is supported by a trained team. The facility is designed to handle different stages of vehicle ownership, from purchasing a new car to servicing and accessing spare parts.
The new outlet takes Toyota’s presence in West Bengal to 45 customer touchpoints.
The Siliguri dealership will retail Toyota’s product range, including the Urban Cruiser Ebella, All-New Camry and Urban Cruiser Taisor.

It will also offer the Innova Crysta, Innova Hycross, Fortuner Legender, Hilux, Glanza, Urban Cruiser Hyryder and Rumion. Toyota’s premium models, including the Land Cruiser 300 and Vellfire, will also be available.
